mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 3% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite GDPC1 QoQ > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive despite INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy in strong labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.2 million units signals strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite HOUST > 1.2 million units.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite FEDFUNDS < 1%.
